```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(seabiRd)

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 12))
```

```{r load-data}
data_all <- read_rds("../data/puffin_clean.rds")
head(data_all)

females <- data_all |>
  filter(sex == "Female") |>
  filter_out(is.na(bred)) |>
  select(date, brood.spot, bred, year) |>
  mutate(year_c = (year - mean(year)) / 10)  # decades from mean year, for interpretable logit-scale priors

females |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = bred, col = as.factor(brood.spot))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth() 

females |> 
  filter_out(is.na(brood.spot)) |> 
  group_by(bred, year, brood.spot) |>
  tally()

females |> 
  group_by(bred, year) |>
  tally()

females_p <- females |>
  drop_na(brood.spot) |>
  group_by(bred, brood.spot, year) |>
  tally()

females |> 
  drop_na(brood.spot) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = bred, col = as.factor(brood.spot))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), 
             alpha = 0.5, 
             data = females_p) +
  geom_smooth(linewidth = 0.75,
              se = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Bred",
       col = "Brood Spot")

ggsave("../figures/smooth_01.png")
```

```{r model_fit}
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b"), # slopes, incl. brood.spot and interaction
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", coef = "year_c"), # skeptical prior on the trend
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "Intercept")
)

# prior predictive check before trusting the priors above
m01_prior <- brm(bred ~ year_c * brood.spot,
                  data = females,
                  family = bernoulli(),
                  prior = priors,
                  sample_prior = "only")

pp_check(m01_prior, type = "stat", stat = "mean")
prior_summary(m01_prior)

m01 <- brm(bred ~ year_c * brood.spot,
           data = females,
           family = bernoulli(),
           prior = priors,
           seed = 42,
           iter = 4000,
           cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1,
           chains = 6,
           sample_prior = "yes",
           file = "../output/m01.rds",
           file_refit = "on_change",
           silent = 2,
           save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE))

summary(m01)
pp_check(m01)

loo(m01)

mcmc_dat <- bayesplot::mcmc_trace_data(m01)
bayesplot::mcmc_trace(m01)
bayes_R2(m01)
```

```{r model_interpret}
# odds ratios for all fixed effects
fixef(m01)[, c("Estimate", "Q2.5", "Q97.5")] |>
  exp() |>
  round(2)

# one-sided test: did breeding odds increase per decade (brood.spot = 0 baseline)?
hypothesis(m01, "year_c > 0")

# one-sided test: same trend for brood.spot = 1 birds (main effect + interaction)?
hypothesis(m01, "year_c + year_c:brood.spot > 0")
```

```{r model_plot}
newdata <- expand_grid(
  year = seq(min(females$year), max(females$year), length.out = 100),
  brood.spot = c(0, 1)
) |>
  mutate(year_c = (year - mean(females$year)) / 10)

preds <- fitted(m01, newdata = newdata, re_formula = NA) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  bind_cols(newdata) |>
  mutate(brood.spot = factor(brood.spot, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Absent", "Present")))

observed <- females |>
  drop_na(brood.spot) |>
  group_by(year, brood.spot) |>
  summarise(prop_bred = mean(bred), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(brood.spot = factor(brood.spot, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Absent", "Present")))

brood_colors <- c("Absent" = "#2a78d6", "Present" = "#eb6834")

preds |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, col = brood.spot, fill = brood.spot)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(y = Estimate, ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5), alpha = 0.15, col = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Estimate), linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_point(data = observed, aes(y = prop_bred, size = n), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = brood_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = brood_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Probability of breeding",
       col = "Brood spot",
       fill = "Brood spot",
       size = "n",
       title = "Model-predicted probability of breeding over time",
       caption = "Shaded band = 95% credible interval. Points = observed yearly proportions, sized by sample size.")

ggsave("../figures/model_predictions_01.png", width = 7, height = 5)
```

```{r model_plot_v2}
# colours from seabiRd::atlanticpuffin instead of the manual blue/orange - for comparison.
# Orange + navy (not the palette's default orange/brown pair) - brown sits too close to
# orange in hue to stay distinguishable once diluted by the ribbon/point alpha. Navy is
# reserved for this Present/Absent legend only; the single-line plots below use red and
# brown so no colour means two different things across figures.
puffin_pal <- seabird_palettes$atlanticpuffin
broodspot_colors <- c("Absent" = puffin_pal[1], "Present" = puffin_pal[4])

preds |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, col = brood.spot, fill = brood.spot)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(y = Estimate, ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5), alpha = 0.15, col = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Estimate), linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_point(data = observed, aes(y = prop_bred, size = n), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = broodspot_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = broodspot_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Probability of breeding",
       col = "Brood spot",
       fill = "Brood spot",
       size = "n",
       title = "Model-predicted probability of breeding over time (v2)",
       caption = "Palette: seabiRd::atlanticpuffin (orange/navy)")

ggsave("../figures/model_predictions_01_v2.png", width = 7, height = 5)
```

```{r model_plot_marginal}
# Overall (marginal) probability of breeding over time, from m01 -
# averaged over each year's ACTUAL observed brood.spot composition rather
# than assuming a fixed split, so any shift in that composition is folded in.
# Averaging on the draws (not the point estimates) keeps posterior uncertainty valid.
females_cc <- females |> drop_na(brood.spot)
epred <- posterior_epred(m01, newdata = females_cc)  # draws x observations

yrs <- sort(unique(females_cc$year))
draws_by_year <- sapply(yrs, function(y) rowMeans(epred[, females_cc$year == y, drop = FALSE]))
colnames(draws_by_year) <- yrs

marginal_summary <- as_tibble(draws_by_year) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "year", values_to = "draw") |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(Estimate = mean(draw), Q2.5 = quantile(draw, .025), Q97.5 = quantile(draw, .975), .groups = "drop")

observed_overall <- females_cc |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(prop_bred = mean(bred), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

marginal_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5), alpha = 0.15, fill = "#2a78d6") +
  geom_line(aes(y = Estimate), linewidth = 0.75, col = "#2a78d6") +
  geom_point(data = observed_overall, aes(y = prop_bred, size = n), alpha = 0.5, col = "#2a78d6") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Probability of breeding",
       size = "n",
       title = "Overall probability of breeding over time",
       caption = "Shaded band = 95% credible interval, marginalised over each year's observed brood-spot mix.")

ggsave("../figures/model_predictions_marginal.png", width = 7, height = 5)
```

```{r model_plot_marginal_v2}
puffin_pal <- seabird_palettes$atlanticpuffin

# red - navy is reserved for "Present" in the split plot above, so this single line
# uses a different hue to avoid one colour meaning two different things across figures
marginal_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5), alpha = 0.15, fill = puffin_pal[5]) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Estimate), linewidth = 0.75, col = puffin_pal[5]) +
  geom_point(data = observed_overall, aes(y = prop_bred, size = n), alpha = 0.5, col = puffin_pal[5]) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Probability of breeding",
       size = "n",

       caption = "Palette: seabiRd::atlanticpuffin (red)")

ggsave("../figures/model_predictions_marginal_v2.png", width = 7, height = 5)
```

Was brood-spot presence *among confirmed breeders* itself changing over time? If so, that
would suggest the main trend above is partly a detectability artefact rather than a true
change in breeding rate.

```{r model_broodspot_fit}
breeders <- females |> filter(bred == 1) |> drop_na(brood.spot)

priors2 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", coef = "year_c"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "Intercept")
)

m02 <- brm(brood.spot ~ year_c,
           data = breeders,
           family = bernoulli(),
           prior = priors2,
           seed = 42,
           iter = 4000,
           cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1,
           chains = 6,
           sample_prior = "yes",
           file = "../output/m02.rds",
           file_refit = "on_change",
           silent = 2,
           save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE))

summary(m02)
```

```{r model_broodspot_interpret}
fixef(m02)[, c("Estimate", "Q2.5", "Q97.5")] |>
  exp() |>
  round(2)

# one-sided test: did brood-spot presence decline over time among breeders?
hypothesis(m02, "year_c < 0")
```

```{r model_broodspot_plot}
newdata2 <- tibble(year = seq(min(breeders$year), max(breeders$year), length.out = 100)) |>
  mutate(year_c = (year - mean(females$year)) / 10)

preds2 <- fitted(m02, newdata = newdata2) |> as_tibble() |> bind_cols(newdata2)

observed_broodspot <- breeders |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(prop_broodspot = mean(brood.spot), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

preds2 |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5), alpha = 0.15, fill = "#1baf7a") +
  geom_line(aes(y = Estimate), linewidth = 0.75, col = "#1baf7a") +
  geom_point(data = observed_broodspot, aes(y = prop_broodspot, size = n), alpha = 0.5, col = "#1baf7a") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Probability of brood spot",
       size = "n",
       title = "Brood-spot presence over time, among confirmed breeders",
       caption = "Shaded band = 95% credible interval.")

ggsave("../figures/model_broodspot_breeders.png", width = 7, height = 5)
```

```{r model_broodspot_plot_v2}
# brown - red is used by the marginal plot above, so this single line gets its own hue too
preds2 |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5), alpha = 0.15, fill = puffin_pal[6]) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Estimate), linewidth = 0.75, col = puffin_pal[6]) +
  geom_point(data = observed_broodspot, aes(y = prop_broodspot, size = n), alpha = 0.5, col = puffin_pal[6]) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Probability of brood spot",
       size = "n",
       title = "Brood-spot presence over time, among confirmed breeders (v2)",
       caption = "Palette: seabiRd::atlanticpuffin (brown)")

ggsave("../figures/model_broodspot_breeders_v2.png", width = 7, height = 5)
```

2007 has only n = 5 observations (vs. 60-220 in other years) - a high-leverage,
low-precision point. Refit `m01` excluding it as a robustness check.

```{r model_sensitivity_2007_fit}
females_no2007 <- females |> filter(year != 2007)

m01_sens2007 <- brm(bred ~ year_c * brood.spot,
                     data = females_no2007,
                     family = bernoulli(),
                     prior = priors,
                     seed = 42,
                     iter = 4000,
                     cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1,
                     chains = 6,
                     sample_prior = "yes",
                     file = "../output/m01_sens2007.rds",
                     file_refit = "on_change",
                     silent = 2,
                     save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE))

summary(m01_sens2007)
```

```{r model_sensitivity_2007_interpret}
cat("Full data (n =", nrow(females), "):\n")
round(exp(fixef(m01)[, c("Estimate", "Q2.5", "Q97.5")]), 2)

cat("\nExcluding 2007 (n =", nrow(females_no2007), "):\n")
round(exp(fixef(m01_sens2007)[, c("Estimate", "Q2.5", "Q97.5")]), 2)

hypothesis(m01_sens2007, "year_c > 0")
```

The odds ratios and the one-sided trend test are essentially unchanged with 2007
removed, so the increasing-breeding-probability conclusion isn't being driven by
that single sparse year.
